Liquidity is only modestly adequate (current ratio 1.18), but the balance sheet is extremely leveraged, with liabilities consuming almost all assets and equity just 3.6% of assets. Combined with very weak operating profitability (EBIT of 446M on 22,217M of revenue), this points to a highly vulnerable credit profile more consistent with the lower speculative-grade range.

DECISION: B-
